assumptions: One process and one active writer per session.
Cancellation does not undo external effects; already recorded terminal results are immutable.
Retry means model request retry, not replay of successful tool work.
Each synchronous decision/record operation is atomic; await boundaries are distinct events.
exclusions: unbounded runs/retries
process kill, power loss, corrupted storage
multiple-process writers
live upstreams, UI rendering and arbitrary external tool effects
